# Ellis Services Group

> Ellis Services Group is part of Ellis Group and provides plumbing repairs, electrical repairs and property maintenance in Perth, Western Australia. 本站提供珀斯管道维修、电气维修和物业维护的中英文服务信息。

## Home / 首页
- [English home](https://perthpipepower.com.au/): Overview of plumbing and electrical repairs for homes, rental properties and managed premises.
- [中文首页](https://perthpipepower.com.au/zh/): 住宅、出租房和管理物业的管道及电气维修服务概览。

## English services
- [Plumbing repairs and installation](https://perthpipepower.com.au/plumbing.html): Service overview covering blocked drains, water leaks, hot water, taps, toilets and fixture connections.
- [Electrical repairs and installation](https://perthpipepower.com.au/electrical.html): Service overview covering fault finding, safety switches, lighting, power points and smoke alarm work.
- [Blocked drains: clearing and repairs](https://perthpipepower.com.au/blocked-drains-perth.html): Assessment and clearing of slow sinks, backed-up showers and blocked toilets, with further drain repairs scoped separately.
- [Water leak detection](https://perthpipepower.com.au/water-leak-detection-perth.html): Investigation of visible and suspected hidden plumbing leaks, distinguishing detection, access and repair work.
- [Hot-water repairs and replacement](https://perthpipepower.com.au/hot-water-problems-perth.html): Assessment of lost hot water, temperature problems and leaking units, including repair and replacement options.
- [Electrical fault finding and power repairs](https://perthpipepower.com.au/power-faults-perth.html): Investigation of lost power, intermittent circuits and recurring faults before the repair scope is agreed.
- [Safety-switch and RCD repairs](https://perthpipepower.com.au/safety-switch-tripping-perth.html): Assessment of recurring trips to identify the affected installation and repair needed, rather than assuming switch replacement.
- [Lighting installation and repairs](https://perthpipepower.com.au/lighting-installation-perth.html): New and replacement lights and flickering LED downlights, with fitting, control and connection requirements assessed.
- [Power point installation and repairs](https://perthpipepower.com.au/power-points-perth.html): Assessment of damaged outlets, failed switches and proposed new or relocated power points.
- [Property maintenance](https://perthpipepower.com.au/property-management.html): Coordinated plumbing and electrical maintenance for rentals, strata buildings and managed premises, including work orders, access and approvals.

## 中文服务
- [管道维修与安装](https://perthpipepower.com.au/zh/plumbing.html): 排水管堵塞、漏水、热水、水龙头、马桶及配件连接等服务概览。
- [电气维修与安装](https://perthpipepower.com.au/zh/electrical.html): 故障排查、安全开关、照明、电源插座和烟雾报警器等服务概览。
- [排水管疏通与维修](https://perthpipepower.com.au/zh/blocked-drains-perth.html): 检查和疏通排水缓慢的水槽、积水淋浴间和堵塞马桶，另外说明进一步排水维修的范围。
- [漏水检测](https://perthpipepower.com.au/zh/water-leak-detection-perth.html): 调查可见或疑似隐蔽管道漏水，区分检测、开口检查和维修工作。
- [热水维修与系统更换](https://perthpipepower.com.au/zh/hot-water-problems-perth.html): 检查无热水、水温异常及热水设备漏水，说明维修和更换选项。
- [电气故障排查与供电维修](https://perthpipepower.com.au/zh/power-faults-perth.html): 调查停电、间歇性电路故障及反复出现的问题，再确定维修范围。
- [安全开关与 RCD 维修](https://perthpipepower.com.au/zh/safety-switch-tripping-perth.html): 检查反复跳闸的相关线路和设备，确定所需维修，而非直接认定需要更换开关。
- [照明安装与维修](https://perthpipepower.com.au/zh/lighting-installation-perth.html): 新灯安装、灯具更换及 LED 筒灯闪烁的检查，涉及灯具、控制和连接要求。
- [电源插座安装与维修](https://perthpipepower.com.au/zh/power-points-perth.html): 检查损坏插座、失灵开关，以及新增或移动插座所需的工作。
- [物业维护](https://perthpipepower.com.au/zh/property-management.html): 为出租房、分层物业和管理场所协调管道及电气维修，包括工单、入场和费用审批信息。

## Company, areas and contact / 公司、服务区域与联系
- [About Ellis Services Group](https://perthpipepower.com.au/about.html): Local repair team, plumbing and electrical services, repair booking process and registered business details.
- [关于 Ellis Services Group](https://perthpipepower.com.au/zh/about.html): 本地维修团队、管道及电气服务、维修预约流程和公司登记信息。
- [Service area directory](https://perthpipepower.com.au/service-areas.html): Directory of six Perth service regions and their plumbing and electrical repair guides.
- [服务区域目录](https://perthpipepower.com.au/zh/service-areas.html): 珀斯六个服务区域及各区域管道和电气维修指南的入口。
- [Contact and repair enquiries](https://perthpipepower.com.au/contact.html): Phone, email, office address and enquiry form for discussing property repairs; an enquiry does not reserve a visit.
- [联系与维修咨询](https://perthpipepower.com.au/zh/contact.html): 电话、邮箱、办公室地址及物业维修咨询表单；提交咨询不等于已预约上门。

## Guides / 维修指南
- [Reporting a plumbing leak](https://perthpipepower.com.au/insights-reporting-a-plumbing-leak.html): What to record about the affected room, timing and water spread, and how inspection, access, repair and restoration differ.
- [如何报告管道漏水](https://perthpipepower.com.au/zh/insights-reporting-a-plumbing-leak.html): 记录受影响房间、漏水时间和水流范围，并了解检查、开口、维修及表面恢复的区别。
- [When a safety switch keeps tripping](https://perthpipepower.com.au/insights-safety-switch-keeps-tripping.html): Observations to report after repeated trips, electrical hazards to avoid, and the distinction between investigation and repair.
- [安全开关反复跳闸](https://perthpipepower.com.au/zh/insights-safety-switch-keeps-tripping.html): 反复跳闸后应报告的现象、应避开的电气危险，以及故障调查和维修的区别。
- [Tenant and property manager maintenance handover](https://perthpipepower.com.au/insights-tenant-property-manager-maintenance-handover.html): Keeping occupant observations, property references, access contacts, cost approvals and work records together.
- [租客与物业经理的维修交接](https://perthpipepower.com.au/zh/insights-tenant-property-manager-maintenance-handover.html): 汇总住户观察、物业编号、入场联系人、费用审批人及维修记录，便于交接。
